market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. AI selloff likely to persist 1-2 weeks as market digests Amodei/Altman warnings. Oil spike supports energy but pressures equities broadly. Fed hike probability rising creates headwind. Expect 3-5% tech drawdown, oil at $95-105/bbl, 10Y yield testing 5.1-5.3%. Volatility elevated (VIX >20).
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI slowdown calls may signal maturation not collapse; structural demand persists. Oil volatility becomes new normal (StanChart). Fed likely peaks then eases by Q1 2027. China credit weakness may force stimulus. EV transition accelerates. Africa/India capital formation creates 5-year opportunity. Key risk: if AI capex actually contracts, 2022-style correction possible.
